name: openoutreach_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the openoutreach capability.

prompts.name: product_description_prompt
prompts.template: Describe your product or service in detail to find matching leads: {product_description}
prompts.use_case: Automated B2B sales prospecting and lead generation.

prompts.name: lead_explanation_prompt
prompts.template: Explain why the following lead fits the product description: {lead_data}
prompts.use_case: Personalized email outreach campaigns for business development.

prompts.name: email_compose_prompt
prompts.template: Compose a personalized outreach email for the lead named {lead_name} based on the product description: {product_description}
prompts.use_case: Startups and small businesses seeking targeted customer acquisition without third-party SaaS.
